HTTP errors, transport errors and missing usage remain uncertifiable failures even after successful native retry; missing/duplicate arms remain in scheduled denominators.

limits: Scripted probes validate instrumentation, not memory competence, quality improvement, provider compatibility or native subscription behavior.
Metadata hygiene is bounded; semantic task contents and generic study/runtime labels remain. It is not a proof against every possible incidental clue or hostile runtime.
Native title timeouts and retries can still occur, within shared accounting; queue repair does not guarantee all provider/client requests complete.
Root alone authorizes freeze/live; no production, controls, scores or live runs were modified by this reviewer.
